# Homework 2 ST 558 Group 2

## Task 1: Basic Vector Practice

I created pre and post treatment vectors

```{r}
# Pre Treatment vector 20 observations
pre <- c(130, 128, 116, 124, 133, 134, 118, 126, 114, 127, 141, 138, 128, 140, 137, 131, 120, 128, 139, 135)
# Post Treatment vector 20 observations
post <- c(114, 98, 113, 99, 107, 116, 113, 111, 119, 117, 101, 119, 130, 122, 106, 106, 124, 102, 117, 113)
```

I assigned the pre and post vectors names of pre and post

```{r}
# Assigning names to vector elements
names(pre) <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")
names(post) <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")
```

I calculated the difference between the before and after and called this difference diff

```{r}
# Difference in blood pressure pre and post 
diff <- pre - post
diff
```

I calculated the average change in blood pressure of all patients

```{r}
# Average of the difference of bp
mean(diff)
```

I determine which patients blodd pressures decreased, which is a positive change

```{r}
# Patients with positvie change in bp list
which(diff>0)
```

I subset the diff vector to show only patients with positive bp change

```{r}
#keep only positive bp changes
pos_diff <- diff[diff>0]
pos_diff
```

I calculated average decrease in bp for only patients who bp decreased

```{r}
# Average decrease among patients who decreased
mean(pos_diff)
```

## Task 2: Basic Data Frame Practice

I creates data frame object with 4 columns

```{r}
# 4 new columns in Data Frame
df_bp <- data.frame(patient = names(pre),
                    pre_bp = pre,
                    post_bp = post,
                    diff_bp = diff)
```

I get only the patients with diff_bp is negative.

```{r}
# Only diff_bp negative rows
df_bp[df_bp$diff_bp<0, ]
```

I created a new column for if post_bp is under 120

```{r}
# Adding a column, read back TRUE if post_bp is under 120
df_bp$below_120 <- df_bp$post_bp<120
df_bp
```

I printed out the data frame

```{r}
#Print data frame using knitr
knitr::kable(df_bp)
```

## Task 3: List Practice

I made a new data frame with using new placebo data

```{r}
#Create new data frame with placebo 10 observations
placebo_pre <- c(138, 135, 147, 117, 152, 134, 114, 121, 131, 130)
placebo_post <- c(105, 136, 123, 130, 134, 143, 135, 139, 120, 124)

# placebo difference pre - post
placebo_diff <- c(placebo_pre - placebo_post)

#Placebo data frame with 4 columns
placebo_df <- data.frame(patient = paste("Subject", 1:10, sep = "_"),
                         pre_bp = placebo_pre,
                         post_bp = placebo_post,
                         diff_bp = placebo_diff)
```

I created and stored a list for the data frames

```{r}
# List for storing both data frames
bp_list <- list(treatment = df_bp, placebo = placebo_df)
bp_list
```

I accessed the first element using 3 types of syntax

```{r}
# Three different methods to look at first element
bp_list[1]           
bp_list[[1]]         
bp_list$treatment    

```

I accessed the pre_bp column of the placebo data frame

```{r}
# Access placebo data frames pre_bp column
bp_list$placebo$pre_bp
```

## Task 4: Control Flow Practice

I created a new column in both data frames for how to catgeorize post bp
```{r}
# Create column for post_bp in both data frames
df_bp$status <- character(20)
placebo_df$status <- character(10)
```

I created categories for the post bp as optimal (0-120), borderline (121-130), and high (131+) in non placebo group
```{r}
# Create status categories in new column for non placebo
# Fill status for treatment group
for (i in 1:20) {
  if (df_bp$post_bp[i] <= 120) {
    df_bp$status[i] <- "optimal"
  } else if (df_bp$post_bp[i] <= 130) {
    df_bp$status[i] <- "borderline"
  } else {
    df_bp$status[i] <- "high"
  }
}
df_bp
```

I created categories for the post bp as optimal (0-120), borderline (121-130), and high (131+) in placebo group
```{r}
# Create status categories in new column for placebo
for (i in 1:10) {
  if (placebo_df$post_bp[i] <= 120) {
    placebo_df$status[i] <- "optimal"
  } else if (placebo_df$post_bp[i] <= 130) {
    placebo_df$status[i] <- "borderline"
  } else {
    placebo_df$status[i] <- "high"
  }
}
placebo_df
```
